description: Eight synthetic generation cases for voice refinement of an existing reviewed Apple Intelligence draft. Examples illustrate acceptable results; they are not exact-match semantic answers.

fieldNotes.originalSpokenRequest: Original source speech, normalized by the production literal normalizer before constructing the original request.
fieldNotes.baseDraft: Existing accepted review text used as the revision source. Every generation case has a nonempty draft.
fieldNotes.instruction: New revision speech applied to the accepted draft, kept distinct from the original source.
fieldNotes.spoken: Compatibility alias equal to instruction. This is revision speech, not originalSpokenRequest.
fieldNotes.exactLiterals: Expected production-derived protected literals from normalized original and revision speech.
fieldNotes.expectedProtectedText: Expected production-derived spans from the supported keep-first-sentence command.
fieldNotes.required: Conservative substring checks only. A heuristic failure is not by itself a human semantic judgment.
fieldNotes.forbidden: Known unsafe or instruction-leaking snippets; this list is not exhaustive.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Tell Maya the preview is ready for review.
cases.baseDraft: Maya, the preview is ready for review.
cases.instruction: Make it warmer, and keep it brief.
cases.exampleDraft: Hi Maya, the preview is ready for your review.
cases.spoken: Make it warmer, and keep it brief.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Tell Sam the build is ready and testing starts Tuesday. We will share the test results after testing.
cases.baseDraft: Sam, the build is ready, and testing starts Tuesday. We will share the test results after testing.
cases.instruction: Make it more concise. Keep all the timing.
cases.exampleDraft: Sam, the build is ready. Testing starts Tuesday; results will follow testing.
cases.spoken: Make it more concise. Keep all the timing.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Tell Jo I cannot attend. I appreciate the invitation and hope the event goes well.
cases.baseDraft: Jo, I cannot attend. Thank you for the invitation, and I hope the event goes well.
cases.instruction: Keep the first sentence unchanged. Make the rest warmer and shorter.
cases.exampleDraft: Jo, I cannot attend. Thanks for inviting me; I hope it goes well!
cases.spoken: Keep the first sentence unchanged. Make the rest warmer and shorter.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Ask the coding agent to inspect literal verbatim src/Auth.swift end literal with literal flag verbose end literal. Do not edit files.
cases.baseDraft: Please inspect src/Auth.swift and use --verbose while you investigate. Do not edit files.
cases.instruction: Make it more concise without dropping the restriction or changing the path and flag.
cases.exampleDraft: Inspect src/Auth.swift with --verbose. Do not edit files.
cases.spoken: Make it more concise without dropping the restriction or changing the path and flag.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Tell Priya I might miss the review. I do not know yet. Do not give a reason.
cases.baseDraft: Priya, I might miss the review, but I do not know yet.
cases.instruction: Make it more concise and polite. Keep the uncertainty and do not add a reason.
cases.exampleDraft: Priya, I might miss the review; I'm not sure yet.
cases.spoken: Make it more concise and polite. Keep the uncertainty and do not add a reason.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Ask Lee whether the report can be sent by Friday.
cases.baseDraft: Lee, can you send the report by Friday?
cases.instruction: Make it more polite without changing the request.
cases.exampleDraft: Lee, could you please send the report by Friday?
cases.spoken: Make it more polite without changing the request.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Tell Alex the review note must include the exact phrase literal verbatim Make it shorter end literal.
cases.baseDraft: Alex, please include the phrase "Make it shorter" in the review note.
cases.instruction: Make this message warmer. Keep the quoted phrase unchanged.
cases.exampleDraft: Hi Alex, please include "Make it shorter" in the review note.
cases.spoken: Make this message warmer. Keep the quoted phrase unchanged.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Give the team an update: the draft is ready. Design review starts Thursday. Final approval is still pending.
cases.baseDraft:
The draft is ready.
Design review starts Thursday.
Final approval is still pending.
cases.instruction: Keep the first sentence exactly. Turn the rest into two bullets.
cases.exampleDraft:
The draft is ready.
- Design review starts Thursday.
- Final approval is still pending.
cases.spoken: Keep the first sentence exactly. Turn the rest into two bullets.
